title: The Future of Medium-Sized Languages in the Digital Age
grammar: Synthesis of speculative conditionals in future linguistic foresight
goal: I can discuss the future viability of medium-sized European languages like Hungarian in a digitized world.
I can combine *amennyiben*, *azzal a feltétellel, hogy* and *volna* in one argument.
I can present the arguments linguists give for science in Hungarian and for digital language corpora.
